name: ThirdShotHub Dink Wall Rebounder Net
description: The ThirdShotHub Dink Wall Rebounder Net lets you practise dinks and resets on your own. Its angled, tensioned net sits at kitchen-line height and sends soft shots back to you at a dinkable pace, so you can drill hundreds of reps without a partner. It folds flat in under a minute and fits in a car trunk.
care_instructions: Fold and store indoors after use. Wipe the frame dry if it gets wet to prevent rust; check net tension every few months.
